video_title: Full Denver Nuggets Postgame Media Availability vs. HOU 🎙

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on team's competitive rebounding and second-chance points
quotes.excerpt: if you can give them one shot, you give yourself a chance
quotes.quote: The first half they had four offensive rebounds, but I feel like they weren't competitive rebounds, they were just bad bounces. As a team, I thought we competed on that end, like we did in the second half of the Boston game, which is such a key against this team because they are already really good. If you give them extra possessions, it's another Kevin Durant shot, or Fred VanVleet. If you can give them one shot, you give yourself a chance. The guys were very competitive tonight.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on the importance of limiting second chance points against high level scorers like Kevin Durant and Fred VanVleet. If you can give them one shot you give yourself a chance.

structured.context: Coach Adelman discusses the team's defensive rebounding performance and the importance of limiting second-chance opportunities against the Rockets.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on team's aggressive play and shooting slump
quotes.excerpt: the only way to get out of a shooting slump is to shoot
quotes.quote: The only way to get out of a shooting slump is to shoot. It sounds stupid and simplistic, but it's not go shoot by yourself or with your PD coach, it's out here competitively. Take it on yourself to do the right things and when you're open, let it go. It was cool to see Christian Braun make a couple, and Christian Braun was three out of five. The really cool thing about those guys is all three guys attacked to play for other people. When you get that out of your two, one, and three, that's 16 assists from those guys. That's a great number, we haven't had that as of late.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman on breaking a shooting slump. The only way to get out of it is to shoot. It is not just about shooting by yourself it is about doing it competitively.

structured.context: Coach Adelman explains his philosophy on overcoming shooting slumps and praises the team's playmaking and ball movement.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Christian Braun's defensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: he's taking on so many unique matchups
quotes.quote: He's taking on so many unique matchups, and we finally got to the matchup we wanted at the end with Aaron on Kevin Durant, and we could move Christian Braun back to Fred VanVleet. I just didn't want Aaron having to chase Kevin Durant for four quarters. That was the ultimate goal, much like the other night with Jayson Tatum, we kind of rotated as we went. Christian Braun was extremely active in the half, I thought he took Kevin Durant out of a lot of actions, and then the end of the game, Fred VanVleet was torching us, and Christian Braun was amazing in the last four minutes, navigating pick-and-rolls, getting under, and that's just rolling on this team.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman praises Christian Braun for his defensive versatility and ability to navigate pick and rolls against elite guards like Fred VanVleet.

structured.context: Coach Adelman explains his defensive strategy regarding matchups against Kevin Durant and Fred VanVleet.

quotes.speaker: Coach Adelman
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Adelman on Christian Braun's responsible defensive gambling
quotes.excerpt: he does it in a very responsible way
quotes.quote: Gambling is a different word. I think he does it in a very responsible way. I think he's attacking the ball when people spin, which I think is a right play in the NBA when guys ISO and over-dribble. I think tonight too, he's gotten into the passing lanes in a correct way. He's not just diving out there getting back-cut. There's different ways to do that. People have been around the NBA, some guys will lead the league in steals, it doesn't mean they're a good defender. Guys will gamble and put their team at risk a lot, but that's not what he's doing. He's staying within the system.
quotes.social_post: Coach Adelman explains why Christian Braun is a smart defender. He is not just gambling for steals he is attacking the ball in a responsible way that stays within the system.

structured.context: Coach Adelman describes Christian Braun's defensive style and how he effectively pressures the ball within the team's system.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokic

quotes.quote: I think we made the shots when we needed and that's what creates assists and that's how just how we play. I think we have we pass the ball a lot and when you make shots you have a lot of assists.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jokic on the Nuggets ball movement. We pass the ball a lot and when you make shots you have a lot of assists.

structured.context: Nikola Jokic comments on the team's offensive rhythm and the correlation between making shots and recording high assist totals.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jokic
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic on the value of struggling and growth
quotes.excerpt: there's beauty in struggling and I love struggling
quotes.quote: I like to say the struggle is there's beauty in struggling and I love struggling and that makes you better, makes you think how to how to prepare, what to do something different. It's really nice when you struggle.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Jokic on the value of adversity. There is beauty in struggling and I love struggling because it makes you better and makes you think about how to prepare differently.

structured.context: Nikola Jokic reflects on the value of facing adversity and how struggling helps the team grow and prepare.

quotes.quote: We scrambled a little bit more. We started mixing up matchups and upped our level of urgency and we were a little bit more desperate.
quotes.social_post: Aaron Gordon on the defensive effort against Houston. We scrambled a little bit more and upped our level of urgency and we were a little bit more desperate.
